scope: Existing public descriptor catalog and isolated synthetic numerical graph-index benchmark. No full N3/N4 transaction workflow measurement; no GPU metadata port.
changes: Detailed native/crypto/graph/final constructor wall-clock timings are emitted as RINGCT_METADATA_TIMING before execute_constructed_case. Timing aggregation, report serialization and proof-exclusion boundary are tested.

One source-owned lazy graph analysis caches fixed census, operation-to-leaf mapping, derived polynomial membership/counts, shared bytes, and exact native source-prefix coverage. Immutable original source, context, family and membership checks remain enforced.

The source preparation original retains room for the analysis before allocation. Bootstrap and blueprint scratch include its construction frames. Thirty-two bounded footprint slots are keyed by descriptor digest, family and complete storage, scoped to the same owner.
Identical parent metadata originals are accumulated by checked category-wise multiplication; serial scratch remains a maximum. Tests compare serial addition and overflow refusal.

Program builders reuse vacant expression probes with per-map identity and generation checks. Stale, moved, cleared, cross-map and growth cases are tested; RandomState hashing and full-key equality remain.

A 528-byte read-only FFT parameter table shares inverse roots and normalization across CPU compilations. All 33 lengths are verified against the field implementation. No columns, coefficients or builder wires are retained globally.
